verses.text: The one sitting in the secret place of the Most High, in the shade of Shaddai he will abide.

segments.text: The one sitting in the secret place of the Most High, in the shade of Shaddai he will abide.

verses.text: I say to YHWH: “My refuge and my stronghold, My God, I trust in Him!”

segments.text: I say to YHWH: “My refuge and my stronghold, My God, I trust in Him!”

verses.text: For He will snatch you from the snare of the trapper, from the plague of calamity.

segments.text: For He will snatch you from the snare of the trapper, from the plague of calamity.

verses.text: With His pinions He will give cover for you, and under His wings you will take refuge; a shield and buckler [is] His faithfulness.

segments.text: With His pinions He will give cover for you, and under His wings you will take refuge; a shield and buckler [is] His faithfulness.

verses.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror of the night, [or] of the arrow [that] flies by day,

segments.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror of the night, [or] of the arrow [that] flies by day,

verses.text: from the plague that walks in the darkness, [or] from the pestilence that destroys at noon.

segments.text: from the plague that walks in the darkness, [or] from the pestilence that destroys at noon.

verses.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and a multitude at your right hand—it shall not draw near to you.

segments.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and a multitude at your right hand—it shall not draw near to you.

verses.text: But with your eyes you shall look, and you shall see the reward of the wicked.

segments.text: But with your eyes you shall look, and you shall see the reward of the wicked.

verses.text: Because You, O YHWH [are] my refuge; the Most High you have made your dwelling place.

segments.text: Because You, O YHWH [are] my refuge; the Most High you have made your dwelling place.

verses.text: Evil shall not meet with you, and plague shall not come near, by your tent.

segments.text: Evil shall not meet with you, and plague shall not come near, by your tent.

verses.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

segments.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

verses.text: Upon the hands they shall lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.

segments.text: Upon the hands they shall lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.

verses.text: Upon the lion and cobra you will tread; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.

segments.text: Upon the lion and cobra you will tread; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.

verses.text: “Because in Me he has delighted, so will I rescue him; I will set him up high because he has known My Name.

segments.text: “Because in Me he has delighted, so will I rescue him; I will set him up high because he has known My Name.

verses.text: He will call on Me and I will answer him; I [am] with him in distress; I will deliver him and honor him.

segments.text: He will call on Me and I will answer him; I [am] with him in distress; I will deliver him and honor him.

verses.text: With length of days I will satisfy him, and cause him to look on My salvation.”

segments.text: With length of days I will satisfy him, and cause him to look on My salvation.”
